candidates.name: roll_all
candidates.desc: All in: reroll at the current level as much as the round's actions allow (down to 0 gold) every round, no xp.

candidates.name: save
candidates.desc: Save: no rerolls; buy xp only toward the lobby curve level (6 at 3-2, 7 at 3-5, 8 from 4-2) and only with the gold above 50, so the interest stays at the maximum.

candidates.name: level_roll10
candidates.desc: Level, then roll: buy xp toward one level up with the gold above 10, then reroll down to 10 gold.
